rules.name: Complimentary DashPass membership (6 months)
rules.eligibility_notes: Requires a U.S. address; card must be used at checkout for DashPass-eligible orders; third-party and digital wallet payments excluded. Six months of complimentary DashPass for DoorDash and Caviar when activated for the first time between 02/01/2025 and 12/31/2029. After the free period, membership auto-renews at the then-current monthly rate until canceled. Membership value stated 'as of 10/01/2026'. Activate by December 31, 2029 by adding the Freedom Unlimited as the default payment method in DoorDash and enrolling in DashPass.

rules.name: DoorDash $10 off one non-restaurant order per quarter
rules.eligibility_notes: Non-restaurant DoorDash orders (grocery, convenience, retail) placed with the enrolled card. Up to $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter through December 31, 2029. Unused discounts do not roll over and have no cash value. Applied as a promotional discount at checkout, not a statement credit. The card used to enroll in DashPass must be used at checkout; requires active DashPass enrollment through the Chase benefit.
